verdict: Leads doubled week-over-week; infrastructure gaps need to close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 39 leads at $6.06 cost per lead, entirely from Meta — and in the most recent week, leads doubled while cost per lead fell 41% compared to the prior week, a strong efficiency signal. That improvement is real, but the sample is still thin at $16.90 in average daily spend, so we're treating it as an encouraging early read rather than a confirmed trend. The more pressing issue is structural: nine planned milestones — including CRM intake, attribution setup, and landing pages — are overdue, which means leads arriving today have no verified path into your pipeline. Closing those gaps is the immediate priority so that the ad efficiency you're seeing now can be properly captured and scaled.
